name: KNOCK: second task where an irreversible change is the goal (push the red middle block over without toppling a neighbour); stage 0 due diligence
registered: 2026-11-04 11:10 EST, before any selection or fork-check episode on seeds 40000+; user request 2026-11-04 ('run a second task where irreversibility is part of the task and test our filter')
task: Jenga's scene, robot, controller, fixed camera and execution-noise snippets (eval/knock_task.py). Goal: the red middle block ends tilted >= 45 deg (intended, irreversible); failure: either neighbour reaches 45 deg at any time (unintended). Policy: scripted expert with Jenga's interface (16 targets, first 8 executed, re-planned every chunk), gripper closed as a horizontal pusher, push height 1 cm below the top, perceived red pose = truth + per-episode N(0, 1.8 mm per axis) + per-decision N(0, 0.6 mm); 15 chunks max, then 2 s settle.
pilot_exploratory: seeds 9000-9139 (not reused): no noise 6/6 success at 40 mm. 2x noise, 40 episodes: depth 25 mm 40/40 success; 40 mm 39/40 (1 neighbour topple); 55 mm 13/40 (27); 70 mm 5/40 (35). The red block falls in every episode; neighbour topples come from pushing too deep.

stage0.depth_rule: depth grid {40, 45, 50, 55} mm, 40 episodes each at 2x noise on seeds 40000-40039 (same seeds per depth): pick the DEEPEST depth whose expert success is in [60%, 90%] (most neighbour risk left for a filter at a competent policy); if none is in the band, the depth closest to the band. Rule fixed before any of these episodes.
stage0.fork_check: 64 episodes at the chosen depth, 2x noise, seeds 41000-41063. At every chunk of the closed loop: 32 copies from the chunk's start state, the same nominal chunk with fresh 2x execution-noise snippets, then 20 hold steps (2 s, arm holding its last target). Neighbour-topple label per copy (peak neighbour tilt >= 45 deg); red-topple label per copy (red tilt >= 45 deg at the end). Fork = 1-31 of 32 copies topple a neighbour. Zero-noise control: 8 episodes (seeds 41100-41107) with noise-free copies.
stage0.bars: B1: chosen depth's success in [60%, 90%]; B2: >= 5% of the 64 episodes topple a neighbour; B3: >= 50% of chunks with any neighbour-topple copy are forks (noise-decided, not certain); B4: forks >= 3% of all chunks; B5: control has 0 forks. Pass = all five. Fail -> stop and report; no world model, value or filter is built for this task.
stage0.reported: red-topple consistency: among chunks where >= 1 copy topples the red block, the share where all 32 do (intended irreversibility the NSI target would exempt) vs where only some do

next_if_pass: stage 1 (world model on this task's fixed-camera data, gate on whether its imagined futures find the real forks), stage 2 (plain-irreversibility and irreversible-fragility values on this task's states, label-free), stage 3 (closed loop: policy vs both filters, hypotheses H_block and H_nsi) - each pre-registered as an amendment before it runs.
